'''New Holstice''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] hospital [[Planet/Legends|world]] between [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]] and [[Roche system|Roche]]. It was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] since before [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], and contained a [[Jedi monument (New Holstice)|monument]] to all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] killed since the formation of the Republic.

The [[Mandalorian Protectors/Legends|Mandalorian Protectors]] [[Battle of New Holstice/Legends|unsuccessfully attacked]] the world in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

The planet was the [[Memory moth/Legends|memory moth]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].
